warmup: Dr. Nair here! One ice cube, zipped in a bag, sitting on a scale. Drag the bag onto the scale and read the number. Then press Wait an hour. Before you look, call it: what will the scale say now?
part1: Three changes, three times on the scale. Read the starting number, press the change button, then type your call before you weigh it. No peeking at the answer first. That is how real scientists keep themselves honest.
part2: Six changes, six undo buttons. Press UNDO and watch. Some come right back. Some are stuck that way forever. Then stamp each card. Keep an eye on the material line at the bottom of every one.
explore: Take the dial all the way up to the stovetop, then all the way back down to the freezer. Watch two readouts the whole time: the mass, and the material. Neither one moves.
